name: WE_CircuitSAT_Impl_BruteForce
title: Brute-force WE for NAND-circuit SAT: an assumption-free baseline submission
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.CircuitSAT.BruteForce.u : Submission P R for WE_CircuitSAT. Enc(phi, beta) outputs [beta] if phi is satisfiable and [false] otherwise; Dec outputs the ciphertext. Both are deterministic machines obtained non-constructively from Machine.exists_finiteAlg_det (hard-wired tables over the finite set of valid inputs). No premises (deps := []); N := WE.cost impl, the cost of these machines, which is not an explicit number. A baseline only: its cost is astronomically large.
